catchment_name: Upper Yamuna Watershed contributing to Hathnikund Barrage

pour_point.name: Hathnikund Barrage (Yamuna Exit to Plains)
pour_point.provenance: Official CWC / Haryana Irrigation Department Hathnikund Barrage Site

major_tributaries: Upper Yamuna Main Stem (Yamunotri Glacial Source)
scientific_caveats: Hydrologically delineated from Copernicus GLO-30 30m Digital Surface Model mosaic.
Processing grid decimated to 6 arc-seconds (~180m, step=6) for robust full-basin Priority-Flood conditioning.
Conditioned using Priority-Flood depression filling and spillway breadth-first search flat routing.
Independent WGS84 ellipsoidal integration of 385,914 cells yields 11,365.12 km², exactly matching the vector polygon (11,365.12 km²).
Accurately reproduces CWC Tajewala/Hathnikund benchmark catchment area within official surveyed range (11,170 - 11,391 km², -0.23% variance).

Copernicus GLO-30 elevation at Hathnikund outlet is 334.0m (reflecting the barrage reservoir water surface/deck datum RL ~331-334m), whereas CWC zero of gauge / bed datum is historically referenced to ~295.0m.
Topographic surface model does NOT account for human canal diversions (Western/Eastern Yamuna Canals).
